descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 五带划分 · 七大洲四大洋 · 六大板块 · 五大陆与洲界
descriptionI18n.en: Climate zones · continents & oceans · six plates · five mainlands & borders

descI18n.zh-CN: 南北回归线之间，有太阳直射，终年高温。
descI18n.en: Between the tropics; the Sun is overhead at some time each year.

descI18n.zh-CN: 北回归线与北极圈之间，四季分明，无直射也无极昼极夜。
descI18n.en: Between Tropic of Cancer and Arctic Circle; four distinct seasons.

descI18n.zh-CN: 南回归线与南极圈之间，四季分明。
descI18n.en: Between Tropic of Capricorn and Antarctic Circle; four seasons.

descI18n.zh-CN: 北极圈以北，有极昼极夜，终年寒冷。
descI18n.en: North of the Arctic Circle; polar day/night, always cold.

descI18n.zh-CN: 南极圈以南，有极昼极夜，终年寒冷。
descI18n.en: South of the Antarctic Circle; polar day/night, always cold.
